items.html: And know that I once heard another [explanation]: that this name Ehyeh in its posterior, which is in gematria blood [44], as above — which is in the Yesod of the woman — and there, because it is in the secret of the posterior, and especially because it is below, it is complete judgment and becomes blood. As is known, the judgments are hard at their end, and at their beginning they are corrected — in the secret of the wine, at whose bottom dregs are made; and when one raises it upward, it becomes milk and is sweetened. For then it ascends there in the name AB of Yods, which is in gematria Hesed; and through the power of its sweetening by the four Yods that are in the filling of the name AB, which are in gematria 40, it is sweetened and becomes milk, which is also in gematria 40.
